fact: MINPOSTEL announced at the August 2026 Internet Governance Forum round table that a bill on open access to public information and digitalisation of administrations, covering inter-institutional interoperability, had been transmitted to the Prime Minister's services, with adoption sought at the November parliamentary session.
title: Dr Pauline Tsafack (MINPOSTEL) : « Le projet de loi sur la digitalisation des administrations est désormais sur la table du Premier ministre »
